company.shortDescription: Airmeet is an all-in-one platform for virtual & hybrid summits, conferences, and events designed for an immersive attendee experience.
company.description: Airmeet serves as an all-in-one virtual events platform for event organizers, marketers, community builders, and enterprises. With a core focus on creating the immersive & integrated virtual events platform for knowledge professionals, Airmeet’s scalable platform supports a variety of event formats including fairs, expos, meetups, workshops, summits, town halls, and more, virtually.

aiResearchSummary.text: Airmeet is researching and developing a computer-implemented conferencing system and method that enhances video conferencing by enabling collaborative computing and remote control through secondary devices. This system authenticates users via a primary device's graphical user interface, facilitating seamless interaction and control during virtual and hybrid events. These innovations aim to improve the immersive attendee experience central to Airmeet's platform.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $35,000,000, or 69.87% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,987,731 to $191,939,416, a 96.56x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
